_comment: content10h overlay, design 'player' (docs/content-10h/designs/player.md), 3 Nov 2026. Six highways (NH 44, NH 48, then NH 19 and NH 44 South in phase 1, NH 66 and NH 16 in phase 2 via the 'phase' key), a Highway Hotel stage on every highway (rooms with 7 levels, a new look at levels 3, 5 and 7), Izzat with 8 perks, Swaad stars per counter recipe slot (10 tiers). Money in ref units (x10 on screen). Six keys are read only by the extended copy of the tool (scratchpad c10/design-player/content10h.py, see player.md s9): content.max_phase, content.visible_levels, hotel.tier_levels, izzat.earn.daily_salaam, mastery.station_mult / slot_mult, content.decor. The project tool ignores them, so its numbers differ a little; every number in player.md comes from the extended copy.

hotel._comment: Highway Hotel: opens when the family stage has all 16 dishes; comes with 2 rooms (charpais in the yard). A room has 7 levels; levels 3, 5 and 7 change its look (charpai with net and bedding, cot under a tin roof, lodge room with a fan). Done = every room built and at level 7, which unlocks the next move. Pays at dawn of each 600 s day cycle; 25 % of its rate while away, up to 8 h. No staff, no cleaning, no closed hours, no extra travellers. Each highway overrides the size and the cost scale. bias 0.25: the bot buys a hotel step when it pays a quarter as well as the best LEVEL UP (players buy what they can see).

izzat._comment: Izzat: never reset, never sold, never spent away from perks. Earned at stage ends, promotions, each Swaad star, baraat steps and the daily salaam (1 a day per dhaba left behind, first session of the day). Bot: cheapest perk first.

mastery._comment: Swaad stars: per counter recipe slot (chai counter recipe 1..4, and so on: 16 slots that carry over to every highway). 10 tiers; a recipe's tier needs threshold x station_mult x slot_mult serves. Each star: +1 % on that recipe's price; +0.5 % on the counter per set level (the lowest star count of its 4 recipes). 1 Izzat per star.

decor._comment: Shaan (EXT, extended copy only): 8 cosmetic dhaba items (truck-art panels, marigold strings, brass samovar, painted charpais, neon HIGHWAY KING board, ...), kept across moves; on sale once the current hotel is done; item k costs base x 2^k x the price mult; +1 % on every price each. The long-tail cash sink after the counters reach L300.
